diagnostics.message: The runner Auto Scaling group can launch its instance before the inline CloudWatch permissions are attached to the instance role. Order group creation after the role policy so startup logging has its required permissions.

The runner Auto Scaling group can launch its instance before the managed policy granting the instance role permission to create Docker Machine resources is attached. Ensure the attachment is complete before instances launch.
The runner Auto Scaling group can launch its instance before the cache-access policy is attached to the instance role. Ensure the attachment is complete before instances launch.

The runner Auto Scaling group can launch its instance before the optional service-linked-role creation policy is attached to the instance role. Order group creation after this attachment when enabled.
The runner Auto Scaling group can launch its instance before the optional SSM access policy is attached to the instance role. Order group creation after this attachment when enabled.
The runner's user data configures CloudWatch logging, but the Auto Scaling group can launch instances before the corresponding log group exists. Order group creation after the log group.

The SSM registration-token parameter is intended to be updated by the runner instance's user data. The Auto Scaling group can launch the instance before this parameter has been created, so order group creation after the parameter.
